description: Diaspora business verification. One diaspora business checked against the registry and the platform's own verification records: VERIFIED with its basis and date, WEBSITE_RECHECK_PENDING, LISTED_UNVERIFIED or NOT_FOUND. NOT_FOUND means not in the registry, never that the business does not exist. $0.1 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

id.description: registry id, e.g. metro-food-hyattsville (this or name required)

metro.description: metro to disambiguate a name match (optional)

name.description: business name, exact or close match (this or id required)

name: verify_diaspora_business
title: Diaspora business verification
